title: Ateneo de Davao Junior High School investigates bullying incident

blocks.text: The Ateneo de Davao University confirmed on Wednesday a bullying incident involving Junior High School students on its campus, saying it immediately took steps to ensure the safety of the student who was hurt and that those found responsible will face appropriate disciplinary measures.
